question: Where is the nearest attraction if you move south from Tunca RiverPark, Robinsonville, MS?
sql: WITH start_location AS ( SELECT p.geometry AS geom FROM parks AS p WHERE p.park_name ILIKE '%Tunca RiverPark%' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Robinsonville%' LIMIT 1)::geography) LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city, p.tourism, ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geom FROM start_location)::geography) AS distance_meters FROM pois AS p, start_location AS sl WHERE p.tourism = 'attraction' AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(sl.geom), ST_Centroid(p.geometry))) BETWEEN 157.5 AND 202.5 ORDER BY p.geometry <-> sl.geom LIMIT 1;
